candidates.name: Toxic epidermal necrolysis
support_spans: widespread erythema, desquamation, and pustulation
separation of the stratum corneum with multifocal subcorneal collections of neutrophils
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and skin biopsy results are consistent with a severe skin reaction.

candidates.name: Stevens-Johnson syndrome
support_spans: severe generalized bullous and pustular rash
skin biopsies from the back demonstrated separation of the stratum corneum with multifocal subcorneal collections of neutrophils
candidates.why: The patient's history of a severe skin reaction and the presence of subcorneal collections of neutrophils support this diagnosis.

candidates.name: Drug-induced lupus erythematosus
support_spans: undifferentiated connective tissue disorder
rheumatoid arthritis
candidates.why: The patient's history of an undifferentiated connective tissue disorder and rheumatoid arthritis, as well as the development of a severe skin reaction after restarting hydroxychloroquine, support this diagnosis.

candidates.name: Hydroxychloroquine-induced hypersensitivity reaction
support_spans: severe generalized bullous and pustular rash
elevated C‐reactive protein level
candidates.why: The patient's history of a severe skin reaction after restarting hydroxychloroquine and the presence of an elevated C-reactive protein level support this diagnosis.

candidates.name: Acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis
support_spans: skin biopsies from the back demonstrated separation of the stratum corneum with multifocal subcorneal collections of neutrophils
candidates.why: The patient's skin biopsy results are consistent with this diagnosis.
